class.name: ResourceImporterCSVDataset
class.brief_description: Keeps comma-separated values files as [CSV] data resources.
class.description: The default importer of [code].csv[/code] files whose header row is not a translation header. It writes no file: the source file is kept (also in exported projects, like [b]Keep File (exported as is)[/b]) and [method @GDScript.load] returns it as a [CSV] resource. Unlike Keep File, the file has the type [CSV] in the FileSystem dock, so it can be selected, inspected and edited in the CSV Table dock. Files whose first row has a column with a known language code (see [method TranslationServer.get_all_languages]) default to [ResourceImporterCSVTranslation] instead. The importer of a file can be changed in the Import dock.
